p: grasshoppers in the beginning of the: To devour the land: and he alludes to the invading of the enemies.
after the king's mowings: After the public commandment for mowing was given: or as some read, when the kings sheep were shorn.
repented for this: That is, stopped this plague at my prayer.
and it devoured the great deep: Meaning, that God's indignation was inflamed against the stubbornness of this people.
with a plumbline in his hand: Signifying that this would be the last measuring of the people, and that he would defer his judgment no longer.

Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel: That is, when Amos had prophesied that the king would be destroyed: for the wicked priest more for hatred he had for the Prophet than for love toward the king, thought this accusation sufficient to condemn him. However, only what the Prophet said could take place.

Amaziah said unto Amos: When this instrument of Satan was not able to accomplish his purpose by the king, he tried by another practice, that was, to scare the Prophet, that he might depart, and not reprove their idolatry there openly, and so hinder his profit.
prophet: Thus he shows by his extraordinary calling, that God had given him a charge, which he must necessarily execute.

Thy wife shall be an harlot: In this way God used to approve the authority of his Prophets, by his plagues and judgments against those who were malicious enemies as in Jer 28:12-17 29:21-26, as this day he does against those that persecute the ministers of his Gospel.
